20/15 Cal Fan Bike @ Recovery Pace

NOTES:
- Keeping this AMRAP simple for today to be able to jump straight in after the lifting. Not much warm-up should be needed, so try to start this within five minutes of your last set of front squat, even if the legs are still a little fatigued.
- On the HARD fan bike efforts, aim for an effort that is definitely fast relative to what you can do, but still sustainable.
- On the recovery pace efforts, still strive to go at the hardest pace you can bike while still recovering for the next round.
